'''Wilkes' Base''' was a [[Exchange]] base located in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was operated by the mutineers of the ''[[Sky Princess]]'' led by [[Sylas Wilkes]].<ref name="TOR:Vengeance" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the [[Sith Inquisitor]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] and the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Andronikos Revel]] attacked the base and killed most of the mutineers, including Wilkes, during their [[search for Tulak Hord's artifacts]].<ref name="TOR:Vengeance" />
